'''Ansil''' was a character in a [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] produced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] who was a refugee that went on to become [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] finest [[sansil]] player.
